plugins.description: Create live booking forms, reservation flows, and question widgets from a prompt — and embed them straight into the site you're working on. No account needed to start.

skills.name: create-widget
skills.description: Create a live Answe question widget (booking form, reservation flow, contact or sign-up form) and embed it into the current website project. Use when the user wants a form, booking widget, reservation flow, lead-capture, sign-up, or contact widget on a site — theirs or a client's. The widget goes live immediately with a share link, an embed snippet, and a claim link; no Answe account is needed to create it.
headings: Create an Answe widget and embed it
